purpose: Diagnostic ownership attribution before the review fixes; not a replacement acceptance benchmark.

provenance.sourceState: HEAD plus pre-review working changes; the tested bundle hash identifies the artifact, not HEAD alone. Captured before subsequent review fixes.
provenance.head: b31e22eb18c240d04ade431e44a80fa60e694aa4
provenance.stage: After automatic maintenance and GC, before undo, typing, or disposal; two mounted views, 200 retained history transactions. Baseline is mounted initial editor before churn.

interpretation.categories: Disjoint shallow self-size totals. Supporting arrays/numbers are separate from tree and piece object rows. Counts include current and historical states; these are not tombstone counts.
interpretation.owners: Dominator retained sizes use the snapshot graph with weak edges excluded, not DevTools ephemeron semantics. Nested rows overlap; owner rows are not additive with shallow categories.
interpretation.inversePayloads: Unique string reachability includes sliced/concatenated parents and can overlap other owners. Required payload units derive from observed nonempty inverse references and the fixture deletion size; UTF-16 units are not physical bytes.
interpretation.native: DOM and external allocation self sizes are separate from Runtime.getHeapUsage JS heap. Snapshot totals and Runtime measurements have different accounting and capture times.
interpretation.measurement: Single diagnostic samples include extra snapshot collection and can affect JIT/allocation timing. They do not replace the 30-case benchmark or alter its 10% median threshold.
interpretation.baseline: Reported browser heap growth already subtracts the mounted-editor baseline. Newly compiled code after baseline is still counted in growth.

inverseEditStrings.note: Unique string nodes reachable from inverse edit text, including sliced/cons parents. Other owners can share these bytes; this is not exclusive retained size.
